name: MP-DocVQA: Multi-Page Document Visual Question Answering Benchmark
description: MP-DocVQA is a multi-page document visual question answering benchmark designed to evaluate document understanding systems across long, multi-page contexts. Introduced by researchers from the Computer Vision Center (CVC) at Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona, MP-DocVQA systematically expands the Single Page DocVQA task to realistic multi-page document retrieval and reasoning. The dataset contains 46,436 questions over 5,929 multi-page documents comprising 47,952 document pages (ranging from 2 up to 20 pages per document). While single-page DocVQA provided only isolated cropped pages, MP-DocVQA provides the full document context, requiring models to simultaneously solve evidence-page retrieval, cross-page reasoning, and question answering.

provenance.curation_notes: An independently published multi-page evaluation benchmark. Reuses questions and target document images from Single Page DocVQA while embedding them within their complete multi-page document contexts (up to 20 pages per document).
